sellers.description: Authorised multi-brand electronics store with 1-year warranty on every device and GST invoices on all orders.
Contemporary and ethnic fashion designed in Jaipur — cotton shirts, dresses, sarees, watches and leather accessories.
Kitchen appliances, cookware, furniture and décor for modern Indian homes, delivered and installed with care.
Dermatologist-tested skincare, makeup and hair tools. Cruelty-free formulas with full ingredient lists.
An independent bookshop from College Street — new fiction, non-fiction and box sets, packed in recycled cartons.
Fitness equipment, yoga gear, bicycles and sports kit tested by our in-house coaches.

products.name: Orbit X5 5G Smartphone (8 GB RAM, 128 GB)
products.description: A bright 6.5-inch 120 Hz AMOLED display, a 50 MP dual camera with night mode and a 5000 mAh battery that charges at 33 W. Dual 5G SIM, in-display fingerprint sensor and three years of security updates.
specs: 8 GB RAM, 128 GB storage (expandable to 1 TB)

products.name: Orbit S21 5G Smartphone (12 GB RAM, 256 GB)
products.description: Flagship performance in a slim glass-and-metal body. A 6.7-inch LTPO AMOLED screen, 50 MP OIS camera with 3x telephoto, IP67 water resistance and 67 W charging that fills the battery in about 40 minutes.
specs: 50 MP OIS + 12 MP ultra-wide + 10 MP 3x telephoto

products.name: Orbit Tab 11 (Wi-Fi, 8 GB, 128 GB)
products.description: An 11-inch 2K display with quad speakers for streaming and study. Works with the Orbit stylus for notes, and the 8000 mAh battery lasts a full day of classes or meetings.

products.name: Nimbus 14 Thin & Light Laptop (Core i5, 16 GB, 512 GB SSD)
products.description: A 1.3 kg aluminium laptop with a 14-inch Full HD IPS screen, backlit keyboard and up to 10 hours of battery. Ships with Windows 11 Home and MS Office Home & Student activated.

products.name: Nimbus Pro 15 Creator Laptop (Ryzen 7, 16 GB, 1 TB SSD)
products.description: Built for video editing and design: a colour-accurate 15.6-inch 2.5K display (100% sRGB), a Ryzen 7 processor and a 1 TB SSD. The dual-fan cooling keeps it quiet under load.

products.name: Keystone Wireless Keyboard & Mouse Combo
products.description: A slim, quiet full-size keyboard and an ergonomic mouse sharing one 2.4 GHz USB receiver. Works up to 10 metres away and runs for 12 months on the included batteries.

products.name: Aura ANC Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
products.description: Hybrid active noise cancellation, 40 mm drivers and 40 hours of playback with ANC on. Soft memory-foam cushions, multipoint pairing with two devices and a 10-minute charge for 5 hours of music.

products.name: Aura Buds Pro True Wireless Earbuds
products.description: In-ear noise cancellation, four microphones for clear calls and 36 hours of total playback with the case. IPX5 sweat resistance makes them gym-ready.

products.name: Aura Studio Bookshelf Speakers (Pair, 40 W)
products.description: A pair of powered wooden-cabinet speakers with 4-inch woofers and silk-dome tweeters. Connect by Bluetooth, optical or RCA — ideal for a TV, turntable or desk setup.

products.name: Aura Classic Wired Headphones
products.description: Lightweight on-ear headphones with a tangle-free braided cable and in-line mic. A warm, balanced sound for commutes and calls — no charging needed.

products.name: Lumen Instant Film Camera
products.description: Point, shoot and hold a print in seconds. Automatic exposure, a built-in flash and a selfie mirror make it easy for anyone to take great instant photos.
specs: Instant square film (10 shots per pack)

products.name: Lumen ZX Retro Mirrorless Camera with 15–45 mm Lens
products.description: A 24 MP APS-C mirrorless camera with classic dials and modern autofocus. Shoots 4K video, has in-body film simulations and a tilting touchscreen for vlogging.

products.name: Pulse Smartwatch Series 3 (AMOLED, GPS)
products.description: A 1.43-inch always-on AMOLED display, built-in GPS, heart-rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking, and 100+ sports modes. Take Bluetooth calls from your wrist and get up to 10 days of battery.

products.name: Men's Slim-Fit Chambray Denim Shirt
products.description: A soft, lightweight chambray shirt with a printed micro-dot pattern. Slim fit, full sleeves and a spread collar — smart enough for the office, easy enough for weekends.

products.name: Men's Formal Cotton Shirts (Pack of 3)
products.description: Three wrinkle-resistant cotton shirts in white, sky blue and burgundy. Regular fit with a semi-cutaway collar and single-button cuffs.

products.name: Men's Rust Bomber Jacket
products.description: A water-repellent bomber with ribbed cuffs and hem, two side pockets and a smooth inner lining. Layers well over tees and hoodies in Indian winters.

products.name: Men's Genuine Leather Biker Jacket
products.description: Classic asymmetric biker jacket in full-grain leather with YKK zips and a quilted lining. It softens and gains character with every wear.

products.name: Men's Slim Tapered Stretch Jeans
products.description: Mid-rise jeans with 2% stretch for all-day comfort and a tapered leg that sits cleanly over sneakers. Lightly faded indigo wash.

products.name: Men's Two-Piece Slim-Fit Suit (Navy)
products.description: A sharp navy blazer and trouser set in a breathable poly-viscose blend. Notch lapels, two-button closure and a half lining keep it light for weddings and work.

products.name: Essential Cotton Crew-Neck T-Shirt
products.description: A 180 GSM combed-cotton tee with a soft hand-feel and a neck that keeps its shape wash after wash. Available in white and black.

products.name: Unisex Brushed Fleece Hoodie
products.description: A warm brushed-fleece hoodie with a lined hood and kangaroo pocket. Relaxed fit that works for everyone.

products.name: Women's Flared Maxi Dress (Red)
products.description: A floor-length georgette maxi with a fitted bodice and a full flared skirt that moves beautifully. Lined, with a concealed side zip.

products.name: Women's Floral Belted Midi Dress
products.description: A breezy rayon midi with a bold floral print, flutter sleeves and a removable belt. Perfect for brunches and summer evenings.

products.name: Banarasi Art Silk Saree with Blouse Piece
products.description: A deep purple Banarasi art-silk saree with a woven zari border and pallu. Comes with an unstitched contrast blouse piece.

products.name: Women's Chikankari Anarkali Kurta (White)
products.description: Hand-embroidered Lucknowi chikankari on soft georgette, in a graceful flared Anarkali silhouette. Comes with a cotton slip.

products.name: Women's Relaxed Jogger Co-ord Set (Mustard)
products.description: A cropped zip jacket and matching joggers in soft French terry. Comfortable for travel, workouts or lounging at home.

products.name: Stride Runner Knit Sneakers
products.description: A breathable knit upper, cushioned EVA midsole and grippy rubber outsole for daily runs and long walks. Weighs just 240 g per shoe.

products.name: Stride Retro Court Sneakers
products.description: Chunky retro sneakers with layered suede and mesh panels and a padded collar. A statement pair that goes with jeans and joggers alike.

products.name: Meridian Classic Chronograph Watch
products.description: A 42 mm stainless-steel chronograph with Japanese quartz movement, sapphire-coated glass and a genuine leather strap. Water resistant to 50 metres.

products.name: Meridian Rose Gold Women's Watch
products.description: A 36 mm rose-gold-tone case with a sunray dial and blush leather strap. Slim, elegant and easy to wear every day.

products.name: Meridian Minimal Leather Watch
products.description: A clean white dial, slim 40 mm case and a quick-release strap you can swap without tools. Comes in a gift box.

products.name: Riviera Polarised Round Sunglasses
products.description: Lightweight gold-tone metal frames with polarised green lenses that cut glare and block 100% of UVA and UVB rays. Includes a hard case and cleaning cloth.

products.name: Voyager Everyday Backpack 25 L
products.description: A water-resistant 25-litre backpack with a padded 15.6-inch laptop sleeve, hidden anti-theft pocket and breathable back panel.

products.name: Voyager Structured Top-Handle Handbag
products.description: A structured vegan-leather handbag with a polished turn-lock, detachable shoulder strap and a roomy interior with zip pocket.

products.name: BrewMaster Drip Coffee Maker 1.2 L
products.description: Brews up to 10 cups of filter coffee with anti-drip pause-and-serve. The hot plate keeps coffee warm for 30 minutes and switches off automatically.

products.name: BrewMaster 600 W Blender with 2 Jars
products.description: Smoothies, shakes and chutneys in seconds. Stainless-steel blades, three speeds plus pulse, and two BPA-free jars (1.5 L and 0.5 L).
specs: 1.5 L blending jar, 0.5 L grinding jar

products.name: Hearth 28 L Oven Toaster Griller (OTG)
products.description: Bake, toast and grill with independent top and bottom heaters, a convection fan and a rotisserie. Temperature up to 230 °C with a 60-minute timer.
specs: Baking tray, grill rack, rotisserie rod

products.name: Hearth Enamelled Cast-Iron Casserole 4.5 L
products.description: A heavy enamelled cast-iron pot for biryanis, curries and slow braises. Even heat, a self-basting lid and works on gas, induction and in the oven.

products.name: Nestwell Stoneware Mug Set (Set of 4)
products.description: Four hand-glazed stoneware mugs with a comfortable handle. Microwave and dishwasher safe — perfect for chai or coffee.

products.name: Lumina Nordic Adjustable Desk Lamp
products.description: A matte steel desk lamp with an adjustable arm and swivel head to put light exactly where you need it. Uses a standard E27 bulb.

products.name: Lumina Dome Pendant Ceiling Light
products.description: A minimal metal dome pendant for dining tables and kitchen islands, with an adjustable 1.2 m cord.

products.name: Nestwell Matte Ceramic Vase Set (Set of 3)
products.description: Three hand-finished ceramic vases in graduated heights. Display them together with dried flowers or on their own as sculpture.

products.name: Nestwell 3-Seater Velvet Sofa (Emerald)
products.description: A mid-century 3-seater in plush emerald velvet with solid wood legs and high-resilience foam cushions. Free delivery and installation.

products.name: Nestwell Accent Lounge Chair (Mustard)
products.description: A cosy accent chair with a curved back, mustard upholstery and tapered wooden legs — ideal for reading corners.

products.name: Nestwell Wooden Counter Bar Stool
products.description: A sturdy counter-height stool in natural beech wood with a footrest ring. Easy self-assembly.

products.name: Nestwell Moulded Dining Chair (White)
products.description: A classic moulded-seat dining chair with wooden dowel legs and a comfortable contoured back.

products.name: Nestwell 300 TC Cotton Bedsheet Set (King)
products.description: A king-size flat sheet and two pillow covers in breathable 300 thread-count cotton sateen that gets softer with every wash.

products.name: Nestwell Microfibre Pillow (Pack of 2)
products.description: Soft yet supportive pillows filled with hollow microfibre that keeps its loft. Hypoallergenic and machine washable.

products.name: Nestwell Chunky Knit Throw Blanket
products.description: A soft acrylic-blend throw with a chunky cable knit. Drape it over the sofa or bed for instant warmth and texture.

products.name: GlowBar 15% Vitamin C Face Serum (30 ml)
products.description: A lightweight serum with stable 15% ethyl ascorbic acid, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid to brighten dull skin and fade dark spots. Fragrance-free and suitable for all skin types.

products.name: Botanica Daily Skincare Ritual Kit
products.description: A complete four-step routine: gentle gel cleanser, rose toner, hydrating serum and a light moisturiser, in travel-friendly glass bottles.
specs: Cleanser 100 ml, toner 100 ml, serum 30 ml, moisturiser 50 g

products.name: Botanica Pink Clay Detox Face Mask (100 g)
products.description: French pink clay and kaolin draw out impurities while rose extract keeps skin soft. Use twice a week for a clearer, smoother complexion.

products.name: Velvet Everyday Makeup Essentials Kit
products.description: Everything for a natural day look: compact powder, blush, nude lipstick, mascara and three soft brushes in a zip pouch.
specs: Compact, blush, lipstick, mascara, 3 brushes, pouch

products.name: GlowBar Hair Styling Tool Set (Dryer, Straightener, Brush)
products.description: A 1800 W ionic hair dryer, ceramic straightener with adjustable heat and a paddle brush — a complete styling kit at home.

products.name: GlowBar Pro 2200 W Hair Dryer
products.description: Salon-grade AC motor with 2200 W of power, a cool-shot button and a slim concentrator nozzle for fast, frizz-free drying.

products.name: Botanica Handmade Soap Collection (Set of 4)
products.description: Four cold-processed soaps with essential oils — lavender, oatmeal honey, sandalwood and charcoal. Each bar is cut and cured by hand.

products.name: Botanica Beard & Hair Growth Oil (30 ml)
products.description: A non-greasy blend of argan, jojoba and rosemary oils that softens the beard and nourishes the skin beneath.

products.name: The Quiet Architect — Meera Nair (Paperback)
products.description: A slow-burning family novel about a Kochi architect who returns home to restore her grandfather's crumbling house — and uncovers the story he never told.

products.name: Monsoon Letters — Arjun Sen (Paperback)
products.description: Told through letters exchanged over one rainy season, a tender story of two strangers in Mumbai and Shillong who find each other by mistake.

products.name: The Last Library of Varanasi — Ritu Kapoor (Hardcover)
products.description: A literary mystery set among the ghats: a young archivist races to save a private library — and the secret hidden in its oldest manuscript.

products.name: Tales from the Western Ghats — Short Stories (Paperback)
products.description: Twelve stories of forests, coffee estates and small towns, by new writers from Karnataka, Kerala and Goa.

products.name: Small Steps, Big Habits — Vikram Iyer (Paperback)
products.description: A practical guide to building routines that stick, with 30 short exercises for focus, health and money habits.

products.name: The Founder's Notebook — Ananya Bose (Paperback)
products.description: Lessons from 40 Indian start-up founders on hiring, fundraising and surviving the first three years, distilled into checklists you can use.

products.name: Java and Spring Boot from Scratch — Rahul Verma (Paperback)
products.description: A hands-on programming guide that goes from Java basics to building and testing a REST API with Spring Boot, JPA and MySQL.

products.name: Classic Indian Essays Box Set (5 Books)
products.description: Five pocket-sized collections of public-domain essays and speeches on education, science and society, in a gift box.

products.name: FlexFit Non-Slip Yoga Mat 6 mm
products.description: A 6 mm TPE mat with a textured non-slip surface on both sides, alignment lines and a carry strap. Light, odourless and easy to clean.

products.name: IronCore Rubber Hex Dumbbells (Pair, 5 kg)
products.description: Rubber-coated hexagonal dumbbells that don't roll away and protect your floor. Chrome knurled handles give a secure grip.

products.name: IronCore Barbell & Plate Set 50 kg
products.description: A home-gym starter set with a 5-foot barbell rod, rubber-coated plates and spring collars for squats, presses and deadlifts.

products.name: IronCore Battle Rope 9 m
products.description: A 38 mm poly-dacron rope with heat-shrink caps and rubber handles for high-intensity conditioning workouts. Anchor strap included.

products.name: IronCore Cast-Iron Kettlebell 12 kg
products.description: A single-piece cast-iron kettlebell with a wide, smooth handle for swings, cleans and goblet squats.

products.name: FlexFit Insulated Steel Water Bottle 750 ml
products.description: Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof lid and a powder-coated grip.

products.name: VeloX Urban Hybrid Bicycle (21-Speed)
products.description: A lightweight alloy hybrid with 21-speed gears, dual disc brakes and 700C tyres for fast city commutes and weekend rides. 85% pre-assembled.

products.name: VeloX Aero Carbon Road Bike
products.description: A full-carbon aero frame weighing 8.4 kg with 22-speed shifting and hydraulic disc brakes, built for fast group rides and sportives.

products.name: ProStrike Leather Cricket Ball (Pack of 2)
products.description: Four-piece alum-tanned leather balls with a raised seam for swing. Suitable for club matches and nets.

products.name: ProStrike Match Football (Size 5)
products.description: A thermo-bonded 32-panel football for true flight and low water uptake, on grass or artificial turf.

products.name: ProStrike Carbon Badminton Racquet
products.description: An 84 g full-carbon racquet with a head-light balance for fast defence and quick drives. Pre-strung at 24 lbs with a full cover.

products.name: ProStrike Graphite Tennis Racquet
products.description: A 100 sq in graphite-composite racquet with a forgiving sweet spot — ideal for intermediate players. Strung, with a cover.
